changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Create finances.frozen_holding_alerts, the per-holding state of the frozen-holding alert (issue #542): whether a frozen holding is above its owner's minimum gain, since when, and when it was last alerted. Keyed by the KIND and EXTERNAL_ID of finances.holdings_overview, never by a merged ticker row, with the kind typed as finances.wallet_kind like finances.holding_daily_snapshots. There is no holding FK because the key spans three tables, so the scheduler deletes the rows of holdings that are no longer frozen or gone.
